units: Blender metres, Z up, character faces -Y, +X is their left
units_in_ouak: OUAK's numbers are centimetres: the Prince's waist rests at 26.345 under a node of scale 1, and his clips write it there. Pew's waist rests at 14.0, so the exporter gives them a waist offset of -12.345 cm (FOLW). The FBX is in metres with every node at scale 1, so it needs a scale of 100 on import to match (unverified in Unity).

new_style.note: OUAK's 23 joint names and parents (OUJI01_D), every joint resting at identity, at positions of Pew's own: the reference is a short pistol with tiny legs and short arms, which the Prince's joint positions cannot carry. The style study notes that OUAK accepts a cousin with its own joint positions under the same names (Kinoko's arm line is higher than the Prince's). Nobody has loaded this rig in the game yet.
